landing.title: Understand how we fly, all the way to orbit.
landing.subtitle: Flyana explains how an aircraft stays up, how a rocket reaches orbit and how a satellite stays there. Clear courses, then a quiz that adapts to your level.

courses.title: Courses that really explain
courses.body: Seven modules, from lift to orbital mechanics: every notion is built step by step, with its formulas and orders of magnitude.

adaptive.title: A quiz that adapts to you
adaptive.body: After each course, a check quiz picks questions at your level. The module is passed at 80 % correct answers.

progress.title: Move at your own pace
progress.body: Earn XP, keep your streak and unlock a badge at every stage of the flight.

scene.alt: A launcher lifts off at dawn from the Guianese coast, above the rainforest, and leans towards the Atlantic.
scene.caption: Kourou, French Guiana: 5° from the equator, the Earth's rotation gives rockets launched east, over the ocean, a 463 m/s head start.

read.title: Read the course
read.body: A structured course, from the simplest to the most advanced, with diagrams, formulas and worked numbers.

check.title: Take the check quiz
check.body: Questions adjust to your answers: never too easy, never discouraging.

validate.title: Pass the module
validate.body: 80 % correct and the module is passed. Every correction is explained and sourced.

sample.title: What it looks like
sample.subtitle: Each question comes after the course that explains it, and each correction tells you why.
sample.question: How fast does a satellite move on a circular orbit 400 km up, like the ISS?
sample.explanation: On a circular orbit, v = √(μ / r). With μ = 3.986 × 10¹⁴ m³/s² for the Earth and r = 6,371 + 400 = 6,771 km, v ≈ 7.67 km/s. 3.1 km/s is the speed on a geostationary orbit, 11.2 km/s the escape velocity at the surface, 29.8 km/s the Earth's speed around the Sun.
sample.source: Source: NASA JPL, Basics of Space Flight

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data Flyana collects, why, how long it is kept and what your rights are. We only collect what the platform needs to work.

controller.title: Who we are
controller.body: Flyana is a platform for learning the basics of aerospace, built by a team of students as part of the ft_transcendence project at 42. It is neither a commercial service nor an official 42 service. The project team is responsible for the data processing described here.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body:
• Account: email address, username, password (never stored in plain text, only hashed with Argon2), avatar, bio, preferred language.
• Sign-in with GitHub, Google or the 42 intra: your account ID at that provider and the email address it sends us. We never receive your password for that provider.
• Activity: the lessons you have read, your answers to check quizzes, your scores, your progress per module and your estimated level in each module.
• Social: your friends list, blocked users and private messages.
• Security: session tokens (stored hashed), your two-factor secret if you enable it (encrypted), last activity time and the IP address tied to some sensitive actions in the security log.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.body:
• To create and secure your account, sign you in and, if you want, enable two-factor authentication.
• To grade your answers, adapt the questions to your level, track your progress and show your statistics.
• To run chat, friends and online presence.
• To protect the platform from abuse (attempt limits, security log).
This processing relies on providing the service you ask for when you create an account, and on our legitimate interest in keeping the platform secure. We do no advertising and no commercial profiling.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body:
Flyana only uses strictly necessary cookies, with no advertising trackers or analytics:
• access_token and refresh_token: keep you signed in (unreadable by JavaScript).
• csrf_token: protects forms against forged requests.
• mfa_token and OAuth state: last a few minutes, during a two-step or provider sign-in.
• flyana_locale: remembers your language.
Your light or dark theme choice is kept in your browser local storage. Since these are essential, they do not require consent.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We never sell or rent your data. Your username, avatar, bio, online presence and public results are visible to other signed-in users. Your private messages are only visible to you and the person you talk to. If you sign in with GitHub, Google or 42, that provider knows you signed in to Flyana, under its own privacy policy.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. Sessions expire automatically and revoked tokens can no longer be used. When your account is deleted, your personal data is erased, except security log entries which may be kept for a few months to investigate abuse.

security.title: Security
security.body: All traffic goes over HTTPS. Passwords and tokens are hashed, the two-factor secret is encrypted, and two-factor authentication is available in settings. No system is flawless, so please use a unique password.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR, you can access, correct, export or delete your data, and object to its processing. You can edit your profile directly in settings. For anything else, including deleting your account, contact the project team: we reply within one month. You can also file a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (cnil.fr).

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this policy changes significantly, the date at the top of the page will be updated and we will let you know on the platform.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of Flyana. By creating an account, you accept them. If you disagree, do not use the platform.

service.title: The service
service.body: Flyana is a free platform for learning the basics of aerospace: courses, adaptive check quizzes, progress, leaderboard, chat and friends. It is a student project built as part of ft_transcendence and is not an official 42 service.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You must provide a valid email address and pick a username that does not impersonate someone else. You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for everything done with your account. An account is personal: do not share it. We recommend enabling two-factor authentication.

conduct.title: Code of conduct

content.title: Your content
content.body: You keep ownership of what you post (answers, messages, avatar, bio). You only allow us to store and display it to run the service. You guarantee you have the right to post it, including any image used as an avatar.

accuracy.title: Educational content
accuracy.body: Courses and questions are written with care and sourced, but they may contain errors or simplifications. They replace neither formal teaching nor reference technical documentation. Scores and badges earned on Flyana have no official value.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: The service is provided as is, with no guarantee of availability or long-term data retention. It may be interrupted, changed or shut down at any time, for example for maintenance or when the project ends.

termination.title: Suspension and closure
termination.body: We may remove content or suspend an account that breaks these terms. You can stop using Flyana at any time and ask for your account to be deleted, as described in the privacy policy.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by law, the project team is not liable for indirect damage arising from use of the platform, nor for content posted by users.

changes.title: Changes and governing law
changes.body: These terms may change: the date at the top of the page shows the latest version, and continuing to use Flyana after a change means you accept it. They are governed by French law.
